trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own when the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the five stages in order and it will come with the last trophy you need.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum has no separate task of its own.
Work the roadmap in order: story, then activities, then collectibles, then the clean-up. Nothing here needs online play.
No DLC is required for any trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The very first main mission. Play Chapter 1 from the start and the trophy pops when Gone Fishing ends.

steps.t: Play the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks when it ends.
It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops as the story carries you into Chapter 2.

steps.t: Play through the end of Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks as the story moves into Chapter 2.
It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

steps.t: Play through the end of Chapter 2. The trophy unlocks as Chapter 3 opens.
It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The trophy pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

steps.t: Play through the end of Chapter 3, then the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. The trophy unlocks with them.
It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops after the final main mission, Starting From Zero.

steps.t: Play through the end of Chapter 4. The trophy unlocks after the final main mission, Starting From Zero.
It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

disputed.topic: Which chapter holds the final mission?

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: The final mission is Starting From Zero, in Chapter 4; finishing it completes Chapter 4.

b.label: Beebom and CULTR (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The final mission is worded as Chapter 5.

disputed.decision: The trophy is 'complete the final mission' either way. Only the chapter label differs, not the requirement.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero. The trophy pops with the story's ending — the chapter label is disputed between sources, but the requirement is not.

steps.t: Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero. The trophy unlocks as the credits roll.
It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — it cannot be skipped or missed.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.
Story missions cannot be skipped, so this trophy cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — it cannot be skipped or missed.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.
Story missions cannot be skipped, so this trophy cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. A story mission — it cannot be skipped or missed.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.
Story missions cannot be skipped, so this trophy cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. A story mission — it cannot be skipped or missed.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.
Story missions cannot be skipped, so this trophy cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, at the airport. A story mission — it cannot be skipped or missed.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.
Story missions cannot be skipped, so this trophy cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — it cannot be skipped or missed.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.
Story missions cannot be skipped, so this trophy cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy on the list, and usually the last one before the platinum. The checklist is forgiving: most things need only part of the total, and nothing toward it can be missed.

steps.t: Open the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. Progress made during the story already counts.
The checklist is lenient — roughly 60% true completion. Most side quests are not needed for it.
Only a few things need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
PSN tracks it as 0/100 — use the counter here to watch it climb.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the world. Mix the four kinds — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest — and the count builds up while you drive and fly.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. 300 of them count toward the 100% checklist.
Four kinds exist: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under the bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix them; under the bridges are the quickest.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
PSN tracks 0/250 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The story introduces most of them by itself, so this one comes naturally while you play.

steps.t: Do each activity type once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt.
Check them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. The story introduces most of them by itself.
PSN tracks 0/9 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds across 12 ranges. The range challenges are not too difficult once you know the layouts.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.
Shooting-range and racing golds are not too difficult; work the ranges one at a time.
PSN tracks 0/42 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — one win at each of the 14 spots. There are 42 races in all; all 42 count toward the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Win a drone race at every one of the 14 Top Fun locations. There are 42 races in all (all 42 for the 100% checklist).
PSN tracks 0/14 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40. Winning the same race twice does not count — you need 20 distinct events.

steps.t: Win 20 different races out of the 40 race locations. A repeat win does not count.
PSN tracks 0/20 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The challenge opens after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when Cal marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing location with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Go to the marked spot, do the quest to unlock the challenge, and beat Cal at fishing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all of its levels at least once. You do not need to beat every challenge inside it.

steps.t: Complete one arcade game: finish all of its levels at least once. You do not need to beat every challenge in it.
Four games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind at the TV at home (from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

gate.mission: A call from Andy during Chapter 3 (Lucia-only)
gate.note: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3. It stays open after the story — but one source warns the chains have story-progress windows, so start it when it unlocks.

disputed.topic: Do the five character questlines stay open after the story?

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: Each questline stays open after the story; all five finales can be finished in free-roam.

b.label: TechWiser (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.

disputed.decision: Start the chain when it unlocks and keep it going. That costs nothing and covers the warning either way.

trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline. It is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3; the five quests end with her final mission. Start the chain when it unlocks — one source warns the questlines have story-progress windows.

steps.t: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only. During Chapter 3, as Lucia, you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address and the questline is marked on the map in Belville.

Finish all 5 of her quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse).
The quests stay open after the story — but start the chain when it unlocks: one source warns the chains have story-progress windows (see Sources differ).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

gate.note: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. Kenton goes away after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 — start it when it unlocks.

disputed.topic: Do the five character questlines stay open after the story?

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: Each questline stays open after the story; all five finales can be finished in free-roam.

b.label: TechWiser (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.

disputed.decision: Start the chain when it unlocks and keep it going. That costs nothing and covers the warning either way.

trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It opens in Chapter 1; Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3, so start it when it unlocks.

steps.t: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), he calls, and he is marked by a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento.

Dive his treasure quests: 7 shipwrecks in all. The quests mark purple treasure chest icons; find the underwater treasures, use the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor, and bring them back to Kenton.

Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and available again at some point in Chapters 2–3 — start early, and note the single-source warning in Sources differ.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

gate.note: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. It stays open after the story — but start it when it unlocks.

disputed.topic: Do the five character questlines stay open after the story?

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: Each questline stays open after the story; all five finales can be finished in free-roam.

b.label: TechWiser (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.

disputed.decision: Start the chain when it unlocks and keep it going. That costs nothing and covers the warning either way.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; the five quests end with his final mission.

steps.t: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.

Finish all 5 of his quests: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job), Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job), The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job).
The quests stay open after the story — with the same single-source window warning as the other finales.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.partial: Only 4 of the 8 counting strands are confirmed so far — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. PowerPyx notes there are more strangers yet to be discovered, so the other 4 strands are not pinned down yet.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but only certain questlines count. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count.

steps.t: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not.
Kirk: the Skunk Ape quests (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove). Kyle: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, and Buddy? (Check on Kyle).

Yago: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper (Mentor Yago), Race Against Yago, and Brother to Brother (Back Up Yago). Pilot Pete: The Last Mile (Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot) and his deliveries.
Only 4 of the 8 strands are confirmed so far; PowerPyx notes there are more strangers yet to be discovered.
PSN tracks 0/8 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

gate.mission: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)
gate.note: Randy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. It stays open after the story — but start it when it unlocks.

disputed.topic: Do the five character questlines stay open after the story?

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: Each questline stays open after the story; all five finales can be finished in free-roam.

b.label: TechWiser (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.

disputed.decision: Start the chain when it unlocks and keep it going. That costs nothing and covers the warning either way.

trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list. It opens in Chapter 3, when you unlock the Key Cloner; he wants 16 sports cars, starting with the Zorrusso delivered in the mission itself.

steps.t: Randy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). During the mission you unlock the Key Cloner to break into high-end sports cars.
He then gives you a list of 16 sports cars he wants, starting with the Granforma Zorrusso delivered in the mission. Track them under Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Randy's Wish List.

He marks some cars automatically in fixed locations, but you can also steal one anywhere off the street. When you scan or enter a car he wants, you get a prompt to deliver it to him; he is marked by a green 'RK' icon in west Vice City.
The cars are often found in east Vice City at Vice Beach or Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Delivering one in good condition pays more.
The questline is still doable after the story — with the single-source window warning in Sources differ.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

gate.note: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty (Jason-only). It stays open after the story — but start it when it unlocks.

disputed.topic: Do the five character questlines stay open after the story?

a.label: PowerPyx
a.text: Each questline stays open after the story; all five finales can be finished in free-roam.

b.label: TechWiser (via CryptoGames)
b.text: The stranger mission chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress.

disputed.decision: Start the chain when it unlocks and keep it going. That costs nothing and covers the warning either way.

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's lab-destruction questline. It opens in Chapter 3, is Jason-only, and ends with his second quest, Spin On This.

steps.t: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is Jason-only. Purple map markers point to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City.
Go to the labs and destroy them (part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After you destroy enough labs, Tyrone gives a second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which unlocks the trophy.
The quests stay open after the story — with the same single-source window warning as the other finales.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

gate.note: The only possibly missable trophy on the list. During Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, Lucia meditates on the balcony at Jason's house — talk to her in the kitchen in the morning and choose Accept. It is gone after Chapter 1.

trophies.unconfirmed: Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required for the trophy is unconfirmed. It adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so nobody has confirmed whether it counts. Do it to be safe.
trophies.guide: Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations — with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts double. This is the one trophy that may be missable: do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before the chapter ends.

steps.t: Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts +2.
Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

POSSIBLY MISSABLE: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth (Meet Brian), Lucia talks about meditating and walks to the balcony at Jason's house in the morning. Talk to her in the kitchen, follow her, and choose Accept when she offers to show you. This meditation is gone after Chapter 1.
Unconfirmed: it is not confirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is required. It adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest. Do it to be safe.
For the 100% checklist only 15 of the 18 are needed — the two numbers count different things.
You cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
PSN tracks 0/18 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.unconfirmed: Which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still being confirmed. Bret's questline is about hunting different animals he requests; the one that pops the trophy is not pinned down yet.
trophies.guide: Hunt for Bret Vogel. His questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is Jason-only. Which animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed.

steps.t: Bret's questline is marked automatically at some point after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. As Jason you get a text from Bret Vogel marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. Lucia cannot receive the message.
Do Bret's quests and bring the animals he requests to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations.
Track progress under Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) > Target Deck. There are 15 Target Decks in all, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist.
Unconfirmed: which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. Any three sets count — pick the ones whose cards you find first.

steps.t: Complete 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Any three count.
PSN tracks 0/3 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with the WAiNK app — any mix counts, and there are more than 100 to choose from.

steps.t: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone: hold Up, then R1 to scan. Any mix counts — 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags.
There are more than 100, so pick any combination.
PSN tracks 0/100 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. You have 10 to spare — and 70 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this one comes on the way to A Long Road.

steps.t: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. 70 of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy unlocks on the way.
Track them under Progress > Challenges. Many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; save the rest for last and pick the easiest ones.
PSN tracks 0/50 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together. It also comes automatically from bank vault robberies in Chapter 4.

steps.t: Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with both characters. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.

Reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. A fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Stay wanted the whole time, and the trophy pops shortly after you leave the third shop.

steps.t: Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted — the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level.
Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs (bought at Ammu-Nations) and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.

A good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Rob a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs.
The unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop. If it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch.

steps.t: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan). Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch.
200 of the 277 base models are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically on the way.
Check your total via Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. PSN tracks 0/100 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Buff Focus first, line up five criminals at a gang operation, and use an assault rifle — it does not count on soldiers, police or civilians.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3 and R3 while aiming a firearm. It slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar at the top left, under health and stamina.

Take down 5 enemies in one use. First buff Focus (food and drinks, or washing your face and showering at home) and consume Adrenaline to extend the time (hold L1, then press Triangle). Line up 5 enemies — criminals at Gang Operations are ideal — and defeat them quickly without missing.

It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 (more accurate than pistols or SMGs, full-auto), and wear body armor to walk out of cover and get close. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal, take off, and fly at least 1 km away.

steps.t: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). It does not work with the passenger planes on the airfield — the plane must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge.

The easiest plane is at terminals E3/E4. Drive through the fences around the airfield and head straight to the plane; next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane.
Inside the plane go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The unlock is delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map. Get in a Rhino and shoot enemies until it pops.

steps.t: Find the military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base.
Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silent back-door entry.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons in unfogged map areas.
Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun. The gadget is permanently in your inventory — no need to equip it. Kicking the door triggers the alarm; the Snap Gun does not.
In the back room, look for the note with the safe code, use the code to loot the safe, then destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store.
A good location: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. The vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…; every vault robbery brings 4 stars, so bring a fast bike.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is automatically marked from story progress. It introduces bank vault robberies, and the first vault is part of the mission.

Tail a security van until it stops at a bank. The guard carries a briefcase with cash into the bank and they open the vault; go in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash yourself — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag.

Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips about security vans. If you have not done Yasmani's previous quests, do those first (robbing 2 Payday Loans); he then sells van tips and marks security vans with a purple icon.

Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs count (all 8 for the 100% checklist), and each pays up to $205,000. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch to another vehicle to become unrecognizable.
PSN tracks 0/5 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way: robbing a large bank vault counts — the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks both.

steps.t: Robbing a large bank vault automatically counts as robbing an armored truck. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks bank vault robberies, so this trophy comes with Maximum Withdrawal.
Or earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks. Block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and blow it open.
The trophy unlocks only after escaping the red heat radius — or using a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are sold in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the black-fog areas.

steps.t: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is to fly a plane over all areas still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible.
PSN tracks 0/52 areas — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs. All 39 operations are needed for the 100% checklist, so this one comes on the way.

steps.t: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in all, and all 39 are needed for the 100% checklist.
Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them; many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
PSN tracks 0/9 gangs — use the counter here.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it next to the bar.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar to unlock the trophy.
Note: one list still had this unconfirmed on 18 Nov; the steps above come from PowerPyx's played-through guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. Only that car counts.

steps.t: First get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy).
Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City. Hack into the car, then drive forward straight through the window.
The unlock is slightly delayed — it pops after driving further away on the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car; it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
Note: one list still had this unconfirmed on 18 Nov; the steps above come from PowerPyx's played-through guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and steal all 3 key valuables. It is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can take what is left.

steps.t: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically during Chapter 2.

Steal all 3 key valuables: the Luxury watch in the office in the south-east corner, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway (blow it up with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations).
The trophy unlocks after escaping the police, not when you pick up the third item. Killing the enemies is not necessary.
It is not missable: if you do not rob all 3 items during the optional mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go again for what is left — you do not need all 3 in one go.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together — the other character trains automatically — and buy a fitness club membership.

steps.t: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select a character) > scroll to Strength (heart icon).
Only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Increase Strength by working out; buy a membership at a fitness club.

Always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner). While actively working out with one character, the other automatically completes training — double progress.
Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are lots all over Vice City. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It comes passively while you rob and fight — do not chase it, and do not push the violence so far that you hit the permanent Irredeemable profile.

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts; it happens passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist.

Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On). Whenever you do something affecting reputation, a little demon face appears on the right side of the screen.

The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable. Professional comes from finishing objectives and robberies stealthily; Hardened from incapacitating enemies without killing them; Violent from killing; Psycho from killing large numbers of cops and civilians or driving over gravestones. Irredeemable is permanent — avoid it.
PSN tracks 0/500 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.unconfirmed: METHOD UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down this trophy's method yet. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; the store is in Vice City, Little Cuba. Until a guide confirms the method, do not chase it.
trophies.guide: No guide has pinned this one down yet. It is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way — but that is not confirmed. Do not chase it until a guide confirms the method.

steps.t: No guide has pinned this one down yet. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; the store is in Vice City, Little Cuba.
Until a guide confirms the method, do not chase it. Check back here after the Sources tab updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside.

steps.t: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, specifically at night after 2AM, and come solo.
The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed. At the roadside you sometimes find a blinking car; if the car is there, the UFO can trigger. If not, drive away and come back.

Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it; the UFO drops the woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.
Note: one list still had this unconfirmed on 18 Nov; the steps above come from PowerPyx's played-through guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians off a bike with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
Do it in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Note: one list still had this unconfirmed on 18 Nov; the steps above come from PowerPyx's played-through guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. A running total across all robberies — it comes naturally while you do the bank vaults for the checklist.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew). It unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.

You need $250,000 in total, not at once — it counts across all robberies. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
PSN tracks $0/$250,000 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there, since they are the most expensive.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It is a running total, not one purchase.

Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest, as they are the most expensive. The city has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
PSN tracks $0/$100,000 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale — $160,000 in all. The 4 story garages do not count. They open for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.

steps.t: Buy the 8 garages for sale, at a total cost of $160,000. The 4 story-related garages do not count.

They become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). You receive a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, is installed on your phone; buy the garages through it.
PSN tracks 0/8 — use the counter here.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need free garage space first, so buy garages before you start registering — and use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep costs down.

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered wherever you are.
To register 10 vehicles you must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more parking spots.

Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Registering costs money — go for cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the expense down.
PSN tracks 0/10 — use the counter here.
